title: Deliver the sourced baseline/alternatives engine and API

acceptance.how: Consume accepted climate/rules and field inputs; preserve unknown evidence.
acceptance.verification: Water/soil/season exclusions precede every preference score.

acceptance.how: Start after current harvest and handle cross-year seasons/duration/overlap.
Search exactly three future main-crop steps after current harvest where supported; retain distinct alternatives and stop honestly when evidence is insufficient.
acceptance.verification: Insufficient evidence returns incomplete without invented filler crops.

acceptance.how: Apply G0-approved preset orders and stable tie-breaking over supported indicators; compare baseline and two distinct alternatives on the same horizon. Totals are optional.
acceptance.verification: No missing criterion is silently scored/reweighted; priorities never bypass exclusions.

acceptance.text: Serve the sourced result through the API
acceptance.how: Serve bundle/plan statuses, common horizon, indicator/check ledger and method/source/catalogue identities with canonical input/result fingerprints.
acceptance.verification: A provenance gate rejects unsupported success and no NASA fetch occurs during requests.

acceptance.how: Saim/Maruf check real inputs and outputs; record relevant tests and merge.
acceptance.verification: One scientific vertical slice is reproducible before G3 integration.

acceptance.how: Evaluate usual crop/fallow segments on the common horizon; retain infeasible baseline findings and separate baseline from past history.
acceptance.verification: Baseline repeats/fallow remain visible; fewer than two supported alternatives leaves comparison incomplete.

acceptance.text: Return source-linked checks and why-not ledger
acceptance.how: Emit stable rule/source IDs, pass/fail/caution/unknown and missing-information actions with translated label keys.
acceptance.verification: No generated prose or fabricated numeric cause; every exclusion traces to a reviewed rule.

acceptance.how: Reuse validation, calendars and constraint functions; assess a proposed crop/window without building a classifier or diagnosing growing crops.
acceptance.verification: The same crop/input receives the same checks in planner and quick assessment.

history.note: Rebased planned work to the mandatory-now/future specifications. No product feature, review or delivery is marked complete.

next_action: Wait for accepted G1 evidence, rules and API contracts; then integrate one vertical slice.
handoff: Prachurjo consumes the reviewed API in G3; Saim/Maruf retain the evidence/domain review trail.
purpose: Turn authentic climate and local agronomy into a tested feasible three-future-crop decision.
